records.frame_name: Visual Foundation / Color, Typography, Spacing, Radius, Elevation
records.purpose: Defines every production color role, type ramp, spacing scale, radius, elevation and border role with token references.
records.interaction_notes: Inspectable token tables; copy token name; no decorative controls without labels.
records.responsive_notes: Tables wrap into token cards below 768px; no horizontal scroll is required for comprehension.
records.accessibility_notes: Contrast values are visible; semantic names and usage notes accompany every swatch.

records.frame_name: Truth Badges / Live, Delayed, Cached, Stale, Simulated, User Entered, Unavailable
records.purpose: Standardizes source and truth semantics throughout every Qelly surface.
records.interaction_notes: Tooltips disclose source, timestamp and confidence; badges never imply unavailable capabilities.
records.responsive_notes: Badges wrap with readable labels and never collapse to color alone.
records.accessibility_notes: Status is encoded by text, icon and color; contrast is verified in every persona.

records.frame_name: Buttons, Inputs, Selects, Checks, Radios, Switches and Segmented Controls
records.state: Default, hover, focus, active, disabled, error, loading
records.purpose: Defines reusable interactive controls and complete interaction state behavior.
records.interaction_notes: Keyboard, pointer and touch behavior are fully specified.
records.responsive_notes: Touch targets are at least 44px; action groups stack on narrow screens.
records.accessibility_notes: Visible focus, programmatic names, error relationships and disabled semantics are explicit.

records.frame_name: Data Grid / Sort, Filter, Pin, Resize, Select, Compare, Export
records.purpose: Defines Qelly analytical table behavior for dense market and evidence data.
records.source_requirements: Typed column data and provenance metadata
records.interaction_notes: Column actions remain keyboard accessible; exports disclose scope and timestamps.
records.responsive_notes: Mobile uses prioritized columns and disclosure rows rather than mandatory horizontal scrolling.
records.accessibility_notes: Headers, sort state, selected rows and summaries are programmatically exposed.

records.frame_name: Chart System / Price, Area, Bar, Distribution, Correlation, Heatmap, Depth
records.state: Loading, live, delayed, stale, empty, error
records.purpose: Defines shared chart structure, legends, source bars, tooltips and state treatment.
records.source_requirements: Series data, units, timestamps and source metadata
records.interaction_notes: Crosshair, tooltip and range controls preserve context and truth state.
records.responsive_notes: Chart controls collapse into labeled drawers; critical values remain visible.
records.accessibility_notes: Text summaries, units and keyboard reachable controls accompany visual data.

records.frame_name: Application Shell / Global Strip, Command Bar, Edge Dock, Rail, Mobile Nav
records.purpose: Defines one coherent navigation and context hierarchy across all routes.
records.interaction_notes: Current location, workspace, search and global actions are always discoverable.
records.responsive_notes: Mobile uses native bottom navigation and modal drawers rather than compressed rails.
records.accessibility_notes: Landmarks, current-page semantics and focus return are explicit.

records.frame_name: Panels, KPIs, Evidence Cards, Saved Cards and Context Blocks
records.purpose: Standardizes visual hierarchy for analytical and operational content.
records.interaction_notes: Clickable cards disclose action; static cards are not styled as controls.
records.responsive_notes: Cards reflow without tiny columns or unreachable content.
records.accessibility_notes: Heading structure and interactive semantics remain correct.

records.frame_name: Dialogs, Drawers, Popovers, Tooltips and Toasts
records.purpose: Defines layered interaction behavior and focus management.
records.interaction_notes: Escape, outside-click and explicit close behavior are defined per layer.
records.responsive_notes: Large dialogs become full-height mobile sheets with safe-area support.
records.accessibility_notes: Focus trap, initial focus, return focus and accessible descriptions are required.

records.frame_name: Form Layout / Validation, Help, Errors, Review and Confirmation
records.purpose: Defines predictable form flow and complete validation messaging.
records.interaction_notes: Inline validation never removes user input; review steps preserve context.
records.responsive_notes: Fields stack and action order remains natural on mobile.
records.accessibility_notes: Labels, descriptions, errors and summaries use explicit relationships.

records.frame_name: Motion System / Reveal, Focus, State Change, Loading and Reduced Motion
records.purpose: Defines restrained motion that never displaces an active target.
records.interaction_notes: Motion communicates hierarchy and status, never hides delayed content.
records.responsive_notes: Motion scale adapts to viewport and performance budget.
records.accessibility_notes: Reduced motion removes transform and nonessential animation.

records.frame_name: Positive, Negative, Neutral, Risk and Confidence Semantics
records.purpose: Protects green/red market meaning while adding text and icon redundancy.
records.interaction_notes: Tooltips explain calculations and comparison basis.
records.responsive_notes: Labels remain visible on mobile; color-only encoding is prohibited.
records.accessibility_notes: All semantics have text, sign or icon alternatives.

records.frame_name: Freshness and Provider State / Live, Delayed, Stale, Offline, Fallback
records.purpose: Makes source recency and provider availability visible before action.
records.interaction_notes: Source inspector opens complete evidence and fallback reason.
records.responsive_notes: Compact chips retain plain-language state labels.
records.accessibility_notes: Live regions announce meaningful transitions without noise.

records.frame_name: Loading System / Skeleton, Progress, Deferred Content and Blocking Work
records.purpose: Distinguishes page loading, partial data and action progress.
records.interaction_notes: Cancel or background options appear only when supported.
records.responsive_notes: Skeletons follow final layout to avoid shift.
records.accessibility_notes: Busy state and status messages are programmatically announced.

records.frame_name: Empty System / First Use, No Results, No Access and Cleared Data
records.purpose: Explains why content is empty and offers a truthful next action.
records.interaction_notes: Primary action is contextual and never creates unsupported capability.
records.responsive_notes: Empty illustrations remain secondary to guidance.
records.accessibility_notes: Meaningful heading and description precede actions.

records.frame_name: Error System / Validation, Network, Provider, Permission and Execution
records.purpose: Distinguishes recoverable input errors from unavailable services and execution failures.
records.interaction_notes: Retry is shown only when safe and supported; no hidden automatic retries.
records.responsive_notes: Error details wrap without clipping identifiers.
records.accessibility_notes: Errors receive focus when appropriate and remain associated with controls.

records.frame_name: Offline and Degraded System / Cached Evidence, Read Only and Recovery
records.purpose: Preserves truthful read-only evidence while connectivity is unavailable.
records.interaction_notes: Unavailable writes are disabled with reasons.
records.responsive_notes: Offline banner stays compact and nonobstructive.
records.accessibility_notes: State changes are announced and controls expose disabled reasons.

records.frame_name: Saved, Shared, Imported and Revision States
records.purpose: Defines complete saved-calculation and evidence lifecycle presentation.
records.source_requirements: Versioned saved records and revision metadata
records.interaction_notes: Create, rename, update, duplicate, delete, restore, import, export and share are separated.
records.responsive_notes: Action hierarchy becomes a native mobile task flow.
records.accessibility_notes: Version state and destructive confirmation are explicit.
records.backend_dependencies: Local persistence and scoped backend contracts

records.frame_name: Security and Isolation States / Scope, Permission, Quarantine and Audit
records.purpose: Makes identity, tenant, workspace and evidence boundaries visible.
records.interaction_notes: High-risk controls require explicit confirmation and audit evidence.
records.responsive_notes: Security context never collapses into icon-only signals.
records.accessibility_notes: Permission and denial reasons are readable and announced.

records.frame_name: IBM Plex Sans Variable / Type Ramp and Numerical Alignment
records.purpose: Defines a readable, analytical type system with tabular numeric support.
records.source_requirements: Locked IBM Plex Sans Variable asset
records.interaction_notes: Scale changes preserve layout and comprehension.
records.responsive_notes: Fluid headings and bounded body measure adapt across viewports.
records.accessibility_notes: Font scaling preserves controls and avoids clipping.

records.frame_name: Qelly Identity / Logo, Burgundy System and Co-brand Boundaries
records.purpose: Protects the official Qelly identity across runtime and review artifacts.
records.source_requirements: Official logo assets and brand tokens
records.interaction_notes: Brand marks are never used as unlabeled controls.
records.responsive_notes: Compact lockups preserve recognition on mobile.
records.accessibility_notes: Decorative and meaningful marks use correct alternative text.

records.frame_name: Accessible Chart Summaries, Tables and Keyboard Inspection
records.purpose: Provides nonvisual and keyboard alternatives for analytical graphics.
records.interaction_notes: Keyboard moves through significant points and linked summaries.
records.responsive_notes: Summary table follows chart on narrow screens.
records.accessibility_notes: Charts expose text summary and structured data alternatives.

records.purpose: Defines native mobile target size, spacing and gesture alternatives.
records.interaction_notes: Every gesture has a visible control alternative.
records.responsive_notes: Targets are at least 46px mobile and do not overlap.
records.accessibility_notes: Touch order follows reading and keyboard order.

records.frame_name: Responsive Grid, Breakpoints and Content Priority
records.purpose: Defines placement logic from 360x800 through 1920x1080.
records.interaction_notes: Primary action and truth context remain visible without horizontal dependence.
records.responsive_notes: Mobile is recomposed, not compressed desktop.
records.accessibility_notes: DOM order follows the meaningful mobile sequence.

records.frame_name: Focus Visibility, Traps, Return and Skip Navigation
records.purpose: Defines consistent keyboard navigation and layered focus behavior.
records.interaction_notes: Opening layers sets meaningful focus and closing restores the trigger.
records.responsive_notes: Focus indicators remain visible against every theme.
records.accessibility_notes: Skip link, landmarks and current-location semantics are required.

records.frame_name: Evidence Package, Checksums, Source Lineage and Artifact Identity
records.purpose: Defines how exact-head evidence and artifact integrity are communicated.
records.source_requirements: Hashes, bytes, commits, runs and checksums
records.interaction_notes: Download and inspection actions disclose exact scope.
records.responsive_notes: Long hashes wrap and copy controls stay reachable.
records.accessibility_notes: Integrity status is textual and machine-readable.

records.purpose: Search routes, assets and commands without losing current context.
records.interaction_notes: Keyboard first; exact selection and escape behavior.
records.responsive_notes: Full-height mobile sheet with safe-area clearance.
records.accessibility_notes: Dialog label, focus trap and result count are explicit.

records.purpose: Find assets with source and freshness state visible.
records.interaction_notes: Selection opens asset route; no unsupported trade action.
records.responsive_notes: Results use a single-column mobile list.
records.accessibility_notes: Combobox and results use accessible names and active-descendant semantics.

records.purpose: Move across product domains and categories with clear hierarchy.
records.interaction_notes: Current domain remains marked.
records.responsive_notes: Nested categories become disclosure rows.
records.accessibility_notes: Current and expanded states are programmatic.

records.purpose: Switch governed workspaces without implying unimplemented accounts or providers.
records.interaction_notes: Current workspace and availability are visible.
records.responsive_notes: Mobile uses a full-width selection sheet.
records.accessibility_notes: Radio-group semantics identify one selected workspace.

records.purpose: Review selected assets or evidence before comparison.
records.interaction_notes: Remove, reorder and open comparison are explicit.
records.responsive_notes: Tray becomes a bottom sheet on mobile.
records.accessibility_notes: Item count and removals are announced.

records.purpose: Review locally configured watchlist evidence.
records.interaction_notes: Add/remove and route navigation are separated.
records.responsive_notes: Single-column mobile list with clear targets.
records.accessibility_notes: Changes use polite live announcements.

records.purpose: Explain market movement using visible evidence and confidence state.
records.interaction_notes: Unavailable state is truthful when no provider evidence exists.
records.responsive_notes: Evidence cards stack by confidence.
records.accessibility_notes: Summary precedes supporting evidence.

records.purpose: Review product and evidence notifications.
records.interaction_notes: Read state and route links are explicit.
records.responsive_notes: Mobile uses full-height list with filters.
records.accessibility_notes: Unread count and status are programmatic.

records.purpose: Expose account, security and appearance routes without claiming production identity connectivity.
records.interaction_notes: Session and security routes remain clearly labeled.
records.responsive_notes: Mobile menu uses touch-safe groups.
records.accessibility_notes: Menu button relationship and focus return are explicit.

records.purpose: Provide native mobile access to all product domains and current location.
records.interaction_notes: Drawer closes on route selection and restores focus.
records.responsive_notes: Safe-area padding and reachable primary routes.
records.accessibility_notes: Dialog/nav landmarks and current page are explicit.

records.purpose: Inspect source, freshness, confidence, method and limitation details.
records.interaction_notes: Copy source and open related evidence remain distinct.
records.responsive_notes: Becomes full-width sheet on mobile.
records.accessibility_notes: Heading and close behavior are explicit.

records.purpose: Switch visual operating persona without changing product truth.
records.interaction_notes: Preview and apply preserve content and route.
records.responsive_notes: Persona cards stack on mobile.
records.accessibility_notes: Selection and description are programmatic.

records.purpose: Switch dark, porcelain, OLED and high-contrast appearance.
records.interaction_notes: Selection applies immediately and persists locally.
records.responsive_notes: Theme samples retain labels.
records.accessibility_notes: Contrast and selected state are explicit.

records.purpose: Adjust content density and font scale without clipping controls.
records.interaction_notes: Changes preview immediately and reset is available.
records.responsive_notes: Mobile prioritizes comfortable density.
records.accessibility_notes: Scale controls have values and descriptions.

records.purpose: Choose chart range, display and evidence options.
records.interaction_notes: Selected tools remain visible and reversible.
records.responsive_notes: Toolbar becomes labeled bottom sheet on mobile.
records.accessibility_notes: Toggle and selected state are explicit.

records.purpose: Inspect exact evidence, lineage, hashes and effective date.
records.interaction_notes: Copy identifiers and open source are explicit.
records.responsive_notes: Long hashes wrap without horizontal dependence.
records.accessibility_notes: Definition list preserves semantic relationships.

records.purpose: Explain the active data source in context.
records.interaction_notes: Hover and focus both reveal the same content.
records.responsive_notes: Mobile uses a popover sheet rather than hover dependence.
records.accessibility_notes: Tooltip relationship and dismissal are explicit.

records.purpose: Explain confidence meaning, inputs and limitations.
records.interaction_notes: No confidence value is shown without methodology.
records.responsive_notes: Content stacks into readable sections.
records.accessibility_notes: Value, scale and explanation are textual.

records.purpose: Explain timestamp, latency and fallback state.
records.interaction_notes: Refresh is available only when supported.
records.responsive_notes: Timestamp wraps and remains visible.
records.accessibility_notes: State is textual and announced on change.

records.purpose: Show provider scope without implying production connection when unavailable.
records.interaction_notes: No credential or execution controls appear in Prompt 2B.
records.responsive_notes: Provider facts stack on mobile.
records.accessibility_notes: Availability and limitation are explicit.

records.purpose: Manage local view presets separately from calculation evidence.
records.interaction_notes: Create, rename and delete are explicit.
records.responsive_notes: Preset cards stack on mobile.
records.accessibility_notes: Current preset and destructive confirmation are explicit.

records.purpose: Define read-only alert configuration without enabling autonomous execution.
records.interaction_notes: Prompt 2B keeps provider delivery unavailable unless explicitly connected.
records.responsive_notes: Form fields stack with review summary.
records.accessibility_notes: Conditions and errors are labeled.

records.purpose: Choose export scope, format and truth metadata.
records.interaction_notes: Format, timestamp and included evidence are shown before download.
records.responsive_notes: Options stack with touch-safe actions.
records.accessibility_notes: Download status and errors are announced.

records.purpose: List available keyboard commands and current route context.
records.interaction_notes: Search and category grouping are keyboard accessible.
records.responsive_notes: Mobile presents commands as reference, not required interaction.
records.accessibility_notes: Keys and actions are readable and not color dependent.
